sections.vendors: No new OSH (contributor 10061) or Interactive Supplier Map update surfaced this week. The sourcing leadership changeover is now live: Monique Leeuwenburgh retires this month after seven years, and Jane Robson (ex-COO, Vogue Sourcing UK; joined August) takes over as Fashion, Home & Beauty Director of Sourcing, Quality and Sustainability, starting with visits to sourcing offices and the supply base.
sections.sourcing: No new country-mix announcement from M&S. In the wider market, Bangladesh's 19% US tariff vs Sri Lanka's stalled 30% is moving US-bound orders to Bangladesh, while multi-market buyers like M&S keep Sri Lankan capacity for UK/EU programmes. Bangladesh is still M&S's largest sourcing base (>$1.2bn a year, and its biggest source of suits).
sections.strategy: On 30 September M&S announced a partnership with Sephora (LVMH) to open shop-in-shops in 100 UK stores, plus an expanded range on M&S.com, from spring 2027. That is the biggest FH&B space reallocation in years. Clothing momentum is still riding on September's London Fashion Week debut (59 looks, buyable straight after the show, half under £50) and the core-range relaunch as 'M&S Collection' under the new quality charter.
sections.pricing: No price-architecture changes announced. The LFW and AW26 message stays 'quality at value', with about 50% of the runway collection under £50. The Beauty Advent Calendar (£75, worth £460) opened early to Sparks members on 1 October ahead of the 13 October launch.
sections.launches: Christmas pre-orders for food opened in early October, and early demand is reported for Christmas home decorations. The AW26 clothing drops continue the 'limited drop' cadence that followed LFW. Beauty Advent Calendar goes on general sale on 13 October.
sections.gossip: City focus is on the H1 results due 4 November. Shore Capital (Clive Black) forecasts H1 pre-tax profit of about £389m and describes M&S as '2–1 up': food is thriving but Fashion, Home & Beauty is lagging in a tougher market. Bernstein holds Outperform (440p) but warns forecasts could be cut, and Berenberg is at about £394m. Shares were at about 379p on 2 October against a consensus target of about 432p, and Artemis disclosed a 5.05% stake in September.
soWhat: New sourcing director plus incoming supplier visits: expect a review of the supply base. Get your compliance, quality data and Plan A credentials (BCI/GOTS/RWS, recycled polyester) up to date now, and ask for an intro meeting during Robson's induction.

Analysts expect Fashion, Home & Beauty to drag in H1, so cost pressure on clothing suppliers could rise around the 4 November results. Prepare value-engineering options rather than waiting for margin-squeeze requests.

Sephora shop-in-shops in 100 stores from spring 2027 will likely take floor space from FH&B. Clothing ranges may tighten towards fewer, higher-quality 'M&S Collection' and Autograph lines, which favours suppliers who can deliver premium fabrics and quick limited drops.
